## Goal

Review copy for unreleased-feature claims (v0.2.0 is the current release, site_src/data/release.yaml) and unclear 'who does this' instructions. Record screen-reader checks as unverified unless actually done.

- docs/vendor/families-accessibility-audit.md lists findings with exact owning file. No copy or page edits.
